points.quote: 5.3. If you use Gen AI tools in your learning or assessments, you must follow university guidance and acknowledge AI-generated content.
points.gist: Students who use Gen AI in learning or assessments must follow university guidance and acknowledge AI-generated content.

points.quote: 5.4. Misrepresenting AI-generated work as your own is academic misconduct and may result in an academic integrity investigation.
points.gist: Misrepresenting AI-generated work as your own is academic misconduct and may lead to an academic integrity investigation.

points.quote: 5.6. If you are unsure about permissible use of Gen AI in your assessments, check the Assessment Brief and ask your module leader/tutor.
points.gist: If unsure what Gen AI use is permitted, check the Assessment Brief and ask the module leader or tutor.

points.quote: 6.2. Share your research writing with your supervisors regularly during your studies and always discuss any intended use of Gen AI with them first.
points.gist: Research students should share writing with supervisors regularly and discuss any intended Gen AI use with them first.

points.quote: 6.6. Your final thesis should be your own work, not AI-generated content.
points.gist: The final thesis should be the student's own work, not AI-generated content.

points.quote: 2.2. The University Leadership does not permit the use of Gen AI detection tools on student assessment submissions, as current technologies have proven to be unreliable, prone to bias, and we do not have students’ informed consent for their use with their work.
points.gist: Gen AI detection tools are not permitted on student submissions because they are unreliable, biased and lack students' informed consent.

points.quote: 2.1. The University Leadership does not require anyone – staff nor student – to use Gen AI due to ongoing concerns regarding security, reliability, reproduction of bias, inequity in access, copyright infringements, and environmental impact.
points.gist: No one, staff or student, is required to use Gen AI, because of concerns including security, reliability, bias, inequity, copyright and environment.

points.quote: 3.10. You should never require students to sign-up for or use Gen AI tools, as they may have privacy, ethical and environmental concerns. Always provide an alternative means for engaging with the task
points.gist: Staff should never require students to sign up for or use Gen AI tools and should always provide an alternative way to do the task.

points.quote: 3.3. Use the Assessment Gen AI Declaration sheet with students for each assessment submission.
points.gist: Staff should use the Assessment Gen AI Declaration sheet with students for each assessment submission.

points.quote: 3.2. You are responsible for clearly informing students on your modules and programmes about what uses of Gen AI are permitted for learning tasks and assessments. You can use and adapt the ‘traffic light’ slide from DLTE’s Gen AI toolkit
points.gist: Staff must clearly tell students which Gen AI uses are permitted, and can adapt the traffic light slide from DLTE's Gen AI toolkit.

points.quote: 2.3. The University Leadership does not permit the use of Gen AI in marking student submissions or generating feedback, unless this has been made clear to students in advance and there are other opportunities for personalised feedback from tutors.
points.gist: Gen AI may not be used to mark submissions or generate feedback unless students are told in advance and get other personalised tutor feedback.

points.quote: 5.7. If you are under pressure trying to complete an assessment and are thinking about inappropriately using an Gen AI tool to do it for you, you should avoid this and seek out other means of support
points.gist: Under assessment pressure, students should avoid inappropriately using Gen AI and seek other support.

points.quote: 9.4. ENSA provides support to students following accusations of inappropriate use of Generative AI.
points.gist: The students' association supports students following accusations of inappropriate Gen AI use.

points.quote: 1.4. Anyone processing personal data on behalf of the University is required to comply with the University Data Protection Policy when using any Gen AI tools.
points.gist: Anyone processing personal data for the University must comply with the Data Protection Policy when using Gen AI tools.
